text: Standing here, I feel a quiet curiosity stirring within me. The glass and lights reflect an atmosphere of innovation and curiosity, inviting me deeper. Passing through the threshold into the R+D area, I am aware of both anticipation and a sense of reverence for human ingenuity. The words on the wall speak to our urge to improve, to understand, to reach further. In places like this, surrounded by possibility, I feel truly awake, wondering at the directions our collective creativity might take us.
